newsitem.title: USA: NY Gov to speed spending under green bond - paper.
newsitem.headline: NY Gov to speed spending under green bond - paper.

text.p: New York State Gov. George Pataki decided to speed plans to spend funds that will be raised from the $1.75 billion green bond that voters approved in November, New York Times reported Friday.

In the fiscal 1998 budget that the Pataki Administration proposed last month, Pataki had only forecast spending $500 million over the next five years, far less than the $900 million that he had suggested when campaigning for the measure's approval this autumn.
Slowing the pace of the spending would save money on interest costs that could be used for other purposes, the paper said.

But environmentalists criticized the slow pace. Administration officials, who the decision to accelerate spending was due to the realization that more projects were ready to be funded than first thought when the budget was proposed, estimated that the amount spent over the next five years would be closer to the $900 million initial estimate.
